name: browser_launch
description: Start the browser shared with the user's BrowserPanel. Choose headless/headful from the task; headless runs no display service. Cloud extension is preferred for compatibility and persistent login. CDP fallback requires explicit selection. Existing browsers preserve their launch mode. Never start another browser to bypass human control.

name: browser_observe
description: Read the current shared browser identity, selected tab, control epochs, accessibility tree and screenshot. Observe again after the user gives control back or switches tabs. Use these exact epochs on the next action; never repeat an input after an uncertain result.

name: browser_action
description: Operate the same tab as the user's viewer. All main/child agent calls share a server control lease. If human control is held, wait for an explicit return and freshly observe; do not use shell, another connection or another browser. Actions: navigate(url), input(input: click{x,y}, text{text}, key{key}, wheel{x,y,dy}), reload/back/forward/new-tab/select-tab/close-tab(targetId). command(method,paramsJson) supports page CDP methods including Runtime.evaluate; paramsJson is a JSON string, e.g. {"expression":"document.title","returnByValue":true}. Evaluation is always gated. No input is replayed. Unused fields are ignored for the chosen kind.
